item.title: Hidden History: Airships
item.description:
In the 1940s, a massive hangar cropped up in the fields of northeastern North Carolina. Inside, it housed light-as-air zeppelins, designed by the Navy to usher convoys safely around German U-boats lurking in the Atlantic, earning them the moniker “Shepherds of the Fleets.”
